title: 1920s Woman in Fur Coat Flapper Fashion, 1929 Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: A "Merry Christmas" To "My Old Friend" Mrs. Woodward. This is the one you said; "You liked best." - 1929 - Harriet C. Fifer
description: A charming 1929 personal portrait photo featuring a woman named Harriet C. Fifer dressed in late 1920s fashion, complete with a cloche hat, a heavy coat featuring plush fur trim on the collar and cuffs, and holding an ornate geometric-patterned clutch. She stands in front of a citrus tree loaded with fruit alongside a wooden house. The back features a handwritten Christmas greeting to her friend Mrs. Woodward.
